positioning: Practical AI agents, AI automation, Codex and Claude Code, AI businesses, and useful AI workflows for entrepreneurs and creators.
target_audience: technically curious operators who want practical AI leverage
content_pillars: multi-agent workflows, memory, tools, and orchestration
strategist_preferences: Prefer ideas Joel can demonstrate, build, test, or explain with first-hand evidence.
Prefer practical outcomes over generic AI news summaries.
Use competitor performance as evidence, not as permission to copy a title or concept.
Trading, Polymarket, and narrow finance topics are adjacent rather than core unless the transferable AI-agent lesson is strong.
Deep developer topics should be translated into a useful builder, entrepreneur, or creator outcome when possible.
